boards.school_name: Missouri University of Science and Technology
boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Missouri S&T spaces for studying, student organizations, making, performances, support, and outdoor gatherings.

cards.title: Havener Center
cards.subtitle: 1346 N. Bishop Ave.
cards.notes: Use the study lounges or arrange a club meeting; the center also has dining, a game room, student involvement, and reservable event spaces.
cards.short_summary: A student-center stop that combines lounges, services, meetings, and food.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T identifies Havener Center as a hub for connection, club meetings, events, relaxing, study spaces, dining, and student involvement.
cards.access_notes: Regular posted hours are 7 a.m.–10 p.m. weekdays; weekend hours vary. Check the center’s current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Curtis Laws Wilson Library
cards.subtitle: 400 W. 14th St.
cards.notes: Start with the floor plan to choose a designated study area, then use the library’s research, course-reserve, and appointment services as needed.
cards.short_summary: The campus library pairs designated study areas with research and course support.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T’s library floor plan identifies study areas, and the library site offers research resources, course reserves, appointments, and interlibrary loan.
cards.source_title: S&T Library Floor Plans | Missouri S&T University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Consult the library website for current building access and service availability.

cards.title: Innovation Lab
cards.subtitle: 650 Tim Bradley Way
cards.notes: Choose an open study area or reserve an eligible shared meeting room; use the lobby and collaboration spaces with current building rules in mind.
cards.short_summary: A newer campus building with open study, collaboration, maker, and meeting spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T says the Innovation Lab includes open study areas, collaboration spaces, a lobby lounge, maker spaces, and student-reservable shared meeting rooms.
cards.access_notes: Posted regular hours are 7 a.m.–10 p.m. weekdays and shorter on weekends; rooms require the applicable reservation process.

cards.title: Student Success Center
cards.subtitle: Innovation Lab, Room 117
cards.notes: Drop in for tutoring information, peer coaching, study support, or a campus-resource referral; check the center’s posted weekday hours before going.
cards.short_summary: A centralized support stop for tutoring, coaching, study strategies, and student resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Success Center provides tutoring options, coaching, study support, events, and campus-resource connections in Innovation Lab Room 117.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–6 p.m. and Friday 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed weekends.

cards.title: Makers Studio
cards.subtitle: Innovation Lab, Room 205
cards.notes: Complete the required safety training before using tools, then plan a project session with staff support across materials such as wood, fabric, electronics, or 3D prints.
cards.short_summary: A supervised making space for hands-on projects after required safety clearance.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T’s Makers Studio provides tools for multiple materials and requires in-person and online safety training for access.
cards.access_notes: Safety training is mandatory. Posted shop hours are semester-specific; email ahead for access outside regular shop hours.

cards.title: Kummer Student Design Center
cards.subtitle: 1051 N. Bishop Ave.
cards.notes: If a design team interests you, use the Student Design and Experiential Learning Center’s join process to connect with a team and its workspaces.
cards.short_summary: The home base for multidisciplinary student design teams and their project facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kummer Student Design Center houses the Student Design and Experiential Learning Center, with design labs, manufacturing space, offices, and support for student teams.
cards.source_title: Student Design and Experiential Learning Center | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: Design-team access and participation follow the center’s membership and safety procedures; do not assume general workspace access.

cards.title: Mineral Museum
cards.subtitle: 129 McNutt Hall, 1400 N. Bishop Ave.
cards.notes: Plan a weekday visit to view minerals, crystals, and fossils in the Earth Sciences and Engineering collection; the department welcomes visitors during business hours.
cards.short_summary: A free on-campus collection of minerals, crystals, and fossils.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T’s Mineral Museum is in McNutt Hall, is open weekdays 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m., welcomes visitors, and has free admission.
cards.source_title: Mineral Museum | Missouri S&T Earth Sciences and Engineering
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m., according to the museum; confirm before a special trip.

cards.title: Leach Theatre
cards.subtitle: Castleman Hall, 400 W. 10th St.
cards.notes: Check the performance calendar, then get tickets through the box office or online for a concert, dance program, student showcase, or other scheduled event.
cards.short_summary: The campus performance venue for ticketed shows and student showcases.
cards.evidence_claim: Leach Theatre presents concerts, dance, Broadway-style productions, student showcases, special programs, and community gatherings.
cards.access_notes: Attendance depends on the event schedule and ticket availability; ticket purchase may be required.

cards.title: The Puck
cards.subtitle: 1870 Miner Circle
cards.notes: Use this outdoor landmark as a meeting point or attend a listed outdoor program; student organizations can reserve tabling space through campus procedures.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor meeting and event location with a distinctive circular landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T identifies The Puck as a student meeting place with semester events and lists it among locations where recognized student organizations may reserve tabling space.
cards.source_title: The Puck | Missouri S&T Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: Outdoor use and tabling are subject to weather, event scheduling, and university reservation procedures.

cards.title: Missouri S&T Stonehenge
cards.subtitle: Northwest edge of campus
cards.notes: Add the half-scale Stonehenge reconstruction to a campus walk, or ask Events and Hospitality Management about approved outdoor-space reservations for a group activity.
cards.short_summary: A half-scale Stonehenge reconstruction and named outdoor campus destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T describes its Stonehenge as a half-scale reconstruction of the ancient monument on the northwest edge of campus.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Spaces | Missouri S&T Events and Hospitality Management
cards.access_notes: Treat it as an outdoor campus landmark; group activities should follow current campus outdoor-space reservation guidance.
